svg.aria-label: Projects. Cozy Arena [live]: Hackathon platform. Checks every upload's content signature; CSRF protection, rate-limited login, admin tools, CSV export. (Flask / SQLAlchemy / SQLite). Ai Judge & Talent Scout [in progress]: Scores real submissions and matches participants to sponsors' stacks from evidence in their code. (Python / Claude API). Eeg-To-Robot [in progress]: Live headset metrics through a quality gate that goes offline instead of guessing. 11 automated tests. (Python / Emotiv Cortex / WebSockets / React / TypeScript). Asl Sign Translator: Recognizes static signs from a webcam entirely in the browser. No frame ever leaves the device. (React / TypeScript / MediaPipe). Historical Influence Engine: A world tree of 59 figures across 15 countries; a time slider re-ranks them live. (React / Flask / Framer Motion). Smartwrite: A 47-class handwriting CNN trained from scratch, behind a React frontend. (PyTorch / React 19). Jetson Nano Vision Bot [in progress]: Drives on its own; real-time face detection and age estimation on the GPU. (Jetson Nano / OpenCV / Python). Mood Project Picker: A seven-question quiz mapped to a three-axis vector, matched against 275 tagged projects. (React / Flask). Robotics Builds: Tetrix competition robot, VEX soccer robot with a kicker, FPV racing simulator. (Arduino / C/C++ / VEXcode). Also: Lua survival game, FluxConvert, chess engine, ARNS travel system, Power BI dashboards.
